description: This file defines the MyTrackerAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for interacting with performance trackers related to employees. It includes methods for listing performance trackers (getAll) and placeholders for other CRUD operations, although they are not implemented. The class uses traits for authentication and service access, and it utilizes OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.
